cause: ComputeTangents normalizes zero accumulated tangent vectors after skipping degenerate UV triangles; these become NaN and UpdateMeshVertices rejects them.
repair_scope: Project editor tangent frames only; authored geometry, normal vectors, UVs and game/runtime source remain unchanged.
fix: PrepareCharacterPreviewTangents retains usable engine-generated tangent frames. For undefined zero/nonfinite frames, it chooses the least-parallel canonical axis and constructs finite orthonormal tangent and bitangent vectors from the authored normal. Albedo, UVs, geometry, animation and target runtime data are unchanged.

original_failure.note: Raw report remains byte-for-byte preserved here. Committed JSON evidence uses UTF-8 LF with the same original failure data.
